# Arka documentation

> How to read these docs. Fetch this file first, then open only the pages you need.
> Site: https://arka-agent.mintlify.site
> Each page is also available as Markdown by appending `.md` (example: /quickstart.md).
> Mintlify also serves /llms-full.txt if you need a single concatenated dump.

Do not invent a product summary. Cite the page you actually read.

## How to access

1. Start here (`/llms.txt`) or the repo-root `llm.txt` if you cloned the source.
2. Pick one page from the map below. Prefer `.md` URLs for lower token cost.
3. For MCP / Cursor / Claude tool use, read `/guides/ai-agents` next.
4. For install and first command, read `/quickstart`.
5. If a path is missing, use site search or `/guides/skills`.

## Start here

- [Home](https://arka-agent.mintlify.site/): what Arka is and how the docs are organized
- [Quickstart](https://arka-agent.mintlify.site/quickstart): install with pipx, setup, first command
- [AI agent guide](https://arka-agent.mintlify.site/guides/ai-agents): MCP tools, routing, verification
- [MCP](https://arka-agent.mintlify.site/guides/mcp): connect Cursor / Claude Desktop
- [Skills catalog](https://arka-agent.mintlify.site/guides/skills): built-in skills
- [CLI](https://arka-agent.mintlify.site/guides/cli): commands and flags
- [Environment setup](https://arka-agent.mintlify.site/guides/env-setup): API keys and providers
- [Troubleshooting](https://arka-agent.mintlify.site/reference/troubleshooting): common failures

## Concepts

- [Routing](https://arka-agent.mintlify.site/concepts/routing): offline symbolic rules, then LLM fallback
- [LLM orchestration](https://arka-agent.mintlify.site/concepts/llm): providers and failover
- [Security](https://arka-agent.mintlify.site/concepts/security): injection blocks and confirmations
- [Comparison](https://arka-agent.mintlify.site/concepts/comparison): how Arka differs from similar tools
